summary: The Fire Core is the elemental heart of the Plane of Fire. All flame, heat, and molten energy originate from this chamber, pulsing outward into the surrounding regions.
history: Formed at the dawn of elemental creation.
The Core’s flame has never extinguished, even during planar collapse.
Pyroclast fissures formed as the Core expanded over millennia.
The Heart of Flame arose as the primal guardian of the elemental fire source.
